title: Fix IDE MCP Server Configs
description: Fix outdated and broken IDE MCP server configurations so each IDE points at the current repo MCP server layout instead of stale paths such as C:\git\compose\repo\mcp. Inspect existing config files, update existing files only, keep changes cross-platform where possible, and validate the resulting commands or paths.
summary: Updated IDE MCP and hook configurations to remove stale repo/mcp, repo/claude, repo/cursor, repo/kiro, and repo/cli paths. Routed Cursor, Copilot, Claude, Kiro, Windsurf, and Droid hooks through bun ./📜️script.ts dev mcp stdio with per-IDE profiles where available. Updated repo CLI config generation to emit the same centralized script.ts-based commands. Added repo-mcp test routing in script.ts and changed MCP project.json test targets to call script.ts from the workspace root, fixing the Windows go.work nested-module failure. Validated JSON configs, hook smoke commands, direct repo-mcp Go tests, and representative Nx targets.
